meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein **dry skin** ke liye mera first pick **Cetaphil Moisturising Cream** rahega—especially agar skin tight, flaky ya easily irritated hoti hai. Isme rich moisturising ingredients hain aur Cetaphil ise dry skin ke liye recommend karta hai. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skin-type/dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Cetaphil Moisturising Cream]()
*₹791*

### Mere top options

1. **Cetaphil Moisturising Cream** — ⭐ Best overall  
   Dry/very dry skin, winter ke liye rich aur reliable.

2. **CeraVe Moisturising Cream** — ⭐ Best for barrier repair  
   Ceramides + hyaluronic acid; agar skin barrier weak hai ya baar-baar dryness hoti hai, excellent choice. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/beauty-blog/top-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [CeraVe Moisturizing Cream]()
*₹422*

3. **Minimalist 0.3% Ceramide Moisturizer** — ⭐ Budget-friendly  
   Ceramide-based option, agar ₹500 ke aas-paas budget rakhna hai.

### [Minimalist Ceramides 0.3% + Madecassoside Moisturizer]()
*₹529*

**Tip:** Moisturizer face wash/bath ke turant baad **thodi damp skin par** lagao—isse moisture lock karne mein help milti hai. Winter moisturizers mein **ceramides, glycerin, hyaluronic acid, shea butter** jaise ingredients useful hote hain. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar tum bata do **face ke liye chahiye ya body ke liye + budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)**, main 2–3 exact best options choose kar dunga.
